description: This file contains a shell script for performing data check and upgrade procedures related to failsafe data verification for U-Boot images on OpenWRT devices. It handles calculating image sizes, checksums, updating environment variables, and performing firmware write operations.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Performs data check and upgrade process for failsafe firmware, including setting environment variables, verifying checksums, and flashing new images.
